messages.subject: Introductory practical workshop to nf-core/airrflow (June 12th 10-11:30 ET, Virtual)
parts:
Interested in analyzing BCR / TCR single-cell or bulk datasets? Join us for a virtual hands-on training on using nf-core/airrflow, a Nextflow pipeline to process start-to-finish AIRRseq datasets using the Immcantation framework.

🕑 June 12th 10-11:30 ET
💻 Virtual (Zoom)
💸 It’s free!

Find out more and register here: https://nf-co.re/events/2025/training_nf-core-airrflow_june
